survivors.claim: genesis-driver.js's MENUS step prints `Read only: .claude/genesis/` (the whole directory) whenever at least one open dimension exists — the normal case — violating Decision D9's explicit ban and the spec's own Contract example for this exact state.
survivors.impact: The one guardrail meant to keep each genesis step's context small is defeated in the MENUS step — the session is told to read the entire .claude/genesis/ directory instead of the specific brief/menu files the step actually needs.
survivors.evidence: Code: `const readFiles = openKeys.length ? [genesisRel('')] : [...]` where genesisRel('') === '.claude/genesis/'. Executed repro against a synthetic root with one open dimension printed `Read only: .claude/genesis/` verbatim. Spec D9 bans exactly this. The only guarding test asserts /^Read only:/ (prefix match) which passes vacuously.
